description: This file defines data models and enumerations for scheduling, targeting, payload, delivery, and logging of Cron jobs within an application. It includes structures for representing Cron schedules, payloads for jobs, delivery modes, session targets, and the main CronJob entity, along with related response and log entry structures.

classes.name: CronJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled Cron job with properties for its configuration, target, schedule, payload, delivery, and execution state.

classes.name: CronJobState
classes.description: Tracks the runtime state and last execution details of a Cron job.

classes.name: CronEvent
classes.description: Represents an execution event of a Cron job with timing, status, and error details.

classes.name: CronRunLogEntry
classes.description: Logs individual Cron job runs with timestamps and status information.

classes.name: CronListResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing a list of Cron jobs.

classes.name: CronRunsResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing a list of Cron run log entries.

methods.name: CronCustomSessionTarget.from
methods.description: Creates a CronCustomSessionTarget from a string value, returning either a predefined or session target.

methods.name: formatIsoDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO 8601 string without fractional seconds.

methods.name: parseAtDate
methods.description: Parses a string into a Date object, with support for ISO 8601 formats.
